message.content: According to the conversation, Li Hua expressed enthusiasm about the upcoming updates in "Call of Duty: Warzone." Specifically, he stated, "Absolutely! I'm always up for something new in the game. I love exploring fresh content and teaming up with friends! Let’s hop on together when the updates roll out!" Therefore, it seems clear that Li Hua plans to play "Warzone" once the updates are released.
